# Test coverage

PHPUnit tests, run via `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `unit-tests-php8*` jobs
(`php phpunit.phar --configuration phpunit.xml`, PHP 8.1+ - see the main
[README](../README.md#supported-php-versions)). `Tests/Stubs/` holds the
fakes these tests are built on (`FakeDb`, `StubBot`, `FakeSettings`,
`FakeTimerCore`, etc.) rather than a real database/AO connection.

**This file is generated by `php Tests/generate-readme.php` - do not edit it
directly.** Source of truth is the one-line docblock above each test method.
Regenerates automatically on commit if you've run
`git config core.hooksPath .githooks` once (see [`.githooks/pre-commit`](../.githooks/pre-commit)).

## `Modules/Ao/MarketTest.php`

| Test | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `testConstructorAddsExactlyOnePollAndOneAutoTrackTimer` | Constructing Market registers exactly one Market-Poll and one Market-AutoTrack timer. |
| `testConstructorDeletesAnyExistingCopiesOfBothTimersFirst` | The constructor issues a cleanup DELETE for both timer names before re-adding them. |
| `testConstructorIsSelfHealingAcrossRepeatedBoots` | Repeated construction (simulating restarts against the same persistent timer table) never accumulates duplicate timers - the cleanup DELETE fires on every boot, not just the first. |
| `testPollAndAutoTrackIntervalsComeFromSettings` | Timer durations/repeat intervals reflect the PollIntervalMinutes/AutoTrackIntervalMinutes settings. |

## `Sources/Log/ConsoleLogHandlerTest.php`

| Test | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `testHandleEchoesFormattedLineVerbatim` | handle() echoes the pre-formatted line unchanged. |
| `testHandleDoesNotMangleJsonOutput` | handle() doesn't prefix/corrupt an already-JSON-formatted log line (regression test). |

## `Sources/Log/DbLogHandlerTest.php`

| Test | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `testHandleEscapesFirstAndSecondAsWellAsMessage` | Category/subtag/message values are SQL-escaped before insertion. |
| `testHandleTruncatesMessageTo500Characters` | The message field is truncated to fit its column width. |
| `testHandleStoresRawMessageNotTheFormattedLine` | The raw message is stored, not the formatter's rendered/decorated line. |
| `testReadsDbLazilyAtHandleTimeNotAtConstruction` | The database reference is read at handle()-time, not captured once at construction - avoids permanently caching a null db from before the bot's DB connection is ready. |

## `Sources/Log/LogDispatcherTest.php`

| Test | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `testUnloggedCategoryOnlyEchoesToConsole` | With Log = off, a record is echoed to console but never written to any file or relayed. |
| `testSecurityCategoryRelaysToGuildChatAndWritesSecurityFile` | A "security" category record is relayed to guild chat and appended to security.txt when the bot is a guild bot. |
| `testSecurityCategoryRelaysToPrivateGroupWhenNotGuildbot` | The same relay goes to the private group instead when the bot isn't a guild bot. |
| `testChatModeOnlyWritesGroupTellPgrpCategoriesToDailyFile` | With Log = chat, only chat-ish categories (group/tell/pgrp) get written to the daily log file. |
| `testAllModeWritesEveryCategoryToDailyFile` | With Log = all, every category is written to the daily log file. |
| `testWriteToDbFlagInsertsIntoDatabase` | A record with writeToDb = true results in a database insert. |
| `testDefaultsToPlainTextWhenSettingsModuleIsNotRegisteredYet` | Mirrors early boot (before Main/06_Settings.php exists): output defaults to plain text, not JSON. |
| `testDefaultsToPlainTextWhenSettingIsUnset` | Settings module is registered, but Log.ConsoleFormat itself was never created/set - still defaults to plain text. |
| `testDoesNotRecurseWhenLogSettingHasNeverBeenCreated` | Regression test: on a bot's very first boot, Log.ConsoleFormat doesn't exist yet, and a naive settings lookup that itself logs on a miss would recurse forever - resolveFormatter() must never trigger that. |
| `testConsoleFormatSettingSwitchesConsoleOutputToJson` | Log.ConsoleFormat = json switches console output to JSON. |
| `testFileFormatSettingIsIndependentOfConsoleFormat` | Log.FileFormat can be set to json while Log.ConsoleFormat stays unset/plain - the two are independent. |
| `testSecurityFileFormatCanBeJsonWhileInGameRelayStaysPlain` | Log.SecurityFileFormat = json only affects security.txt - the in-game relay text stays plain. |
